d: As a Service Trainer, you’ll play a key role in developing the skills and expertise of our field service teams and customers. You’ll deliver practical training on PGSV portfolio including high voltage systems and equipment, ensuring safe and reliable operations across the industry. This position offers the chance to work with advanced technologies, collaborate with diverse teams, and contribute to the ongoing success of a global leader in power solutions. If you have a strong technical background and a passion for sharing knowledge, this is an excellent opportunity to advance your career while making a meaningful impact in the power sector. Experience in high voltage equipment such as breakers, GIS, GCBs, PASS, disconnectors, power quality equipment, or digital stations will set you apart and allow you to make an even greater impact.
q: A Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering.
Minimum 5 years of experience in a technical or field service role, ideally with high voltage equipment.

Familiarity with high voltage equipment such as High Voltage Breakers (Dead Tank, Live Tank), GIS (Gas Insulated Switchgear), GCB (Generator Circuit Breaker), PASS (Plug & Switch System), High Voltage Disconnectors and Grounding Switches, Power Quality Equipment, and Digital Stations is a significant differentiator.
Excellent communication skills in Arabic and in English and ability to collaborate in cross-functional team.
Ability to interpret technical drawings and engineering concepts.
Proficiency in both spoken and written English is required.
